name: Molecular Energies PLC
summary: Molecular Energies PLC engages in the exploration, evaluation, and production of oil and gas properties primarily in South America. The company holds exploration assets in Argentina, the United States, and Paraguay. It also sells hydrocarbons. The company was formerly known as President Petroleum Company PLC and changed its name to Molecular Energies PLC in September 2012. Molecular Energies PLC was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Leeds, the United Kingdom.
